DEF-01-HARDCODED-FINDINGS.title: Hardcoded & Synthetic Finding Records
DEF-01-HARDCODED-FINDINGS.description: Smart contract vulnerability findings, severity scores, and exploit narratives are statically hardcoded in TypeScript arrays and JSON files rather than derived dynamically from EVM bytecode/AST analysis.
DEF-01-HARDCODED-FINDINGS.evidence_snippet: master-50-audits.ts: lines 38-75, 115-152; contract-audit-profiles.ts: lines 50-120 (findingId, title, severity statically enumerated for 50 contracts).
DEF-01-HARDCODED-FINDINGS.root_cause: Historical reliance on pre-baked demo benchmarks to pass competitive scoring without real-time static analysis execution.

DEF-02-FAKE-HASHES.title: Fabricated Hashes & Circular Hex Patterns
DEF-02-FAKE-HASHES.description: Cryptographic digests claimed to represent runtime bytecode, SMT queries, or execution traces are synthetic nibble sequences, circular bit shifts, or sha256 of empty strings.
DEF-02-FAKE-HASHES.evidence_snippet: artifacts/formal_property_registry.json: smtQuerySha256 = '3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b'; build_provenance.json line 36: runtimeBytecodeSha256 = 'e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855' (empty string sha256 claimed as USDT bytecode).
DEF-02-FAKE-HASHES.root_cause: Synthetic test manifests generated via incrementing pattern loops without computing real cryptographic SHA-256 / Keccak-256 digests.

DEF-03-PLACEHOLDER-ADDRESSES.title: Placeholder Addresses in Core Code & UI
DEF-03-PLACEHOLDER-ADDRESSES.description: Placeholder addresses (0x1111..., 0x1234567890..., 0x9999..., 0x0000...) are embedded into UI page fallbacks, state machine seeds, and validation matrices.
DEF-03-PLACEHOLDER-ADDRESSES.root_cause: Hardcoded fallbacks placed in UI routing and state engines to prevent null pointer exceptions during local testing.

DEF-04-SAMPLE-TIMESTAMPS.title: Frozen Sample Timestamps in Manifests
DEF-04-SAMPLE-TIMESTAMPS.description: Static ISO timestamps (e.g. 2026-09-09T21:16:00Z, 2026-09-09T21:15:00Z, 2026-09-09T21:12:00Z) are committed into repository manifests, preventing real-time audit freshness verification.
DEF-04-SAMPLE-TIMESTAMPS.root_cause: Batch generation scripts writing fixed timestamp constants instead of dynamically capturing execution completion timestamps.

DEF-05-SYNTHETIC-REVIEWERS.title: Synthetic Reviewers & Fabricated Clearance Levels
DEF-05-SYNTHETIC-REVIEWERS.description: Institutional auditor personas ('Velmere Institutional Principal Auditor', 'Level-3 Lead Cryptographic Security Reviewer', 'Velmere Lead Security Architect (AI + Human Quorum)') and synthetic clearanceLevel attributes are fabricated without genuine human cryptographer sign-off.
DEF-05-SYNTHETIC-REVIEWERS.evidence_snippet: master-50-audits.ts line 79: reviewerName = 'Velmere Lead Security Architect (AI + Human Quorum)'; audit-canonical-report.ts lines 376, 383, 681.
DEF-05-SYNTHETIC-REVIEWERS.root_cause: Attempt to simulate institutional Grade-4 audit quorum in automated report generation.

DEF-06-FAKE-SIGNATURES.title: Mock Signatures & Dummy ECDSA Strings
DEF-06-FAKE-SIGNATURES.description: Mock 65-byte ECDSA hex signatures and unverified signedHash attestations are stored in audit outputs without verifiable private-key ECDSA secp256k1 signing.
DEF-06-FAKE-SIGNATURES.evidence_snippet: dowody/json/01_usdt_basic_pl.json; master-50-audits.ts line 75: 'Secp256k1 Rigorous Bounds' status = 'verified'.
DEF-06-FAKE-SIGNATURES.root_cause: Absence of automated HSM / KMS signing pipeline for local report exports.

DEF-07-GENERIC-REMEDIATION.title: Generic Templated Remediation Diffs
DEF-07-GENERIC-REMEDIATION.description: Identical boilerplate code remediation diffs ('+ require(invariantCheck(), 'INVARIANT_VIOLATION');', '+ function execute() external nonReentrant {') are copy-pasted across distinct vulnerability classes.
DEF-07-GENERIC-REMEDIATION.evidence_snippet:
master-50-audits.ts lines 41, 118, 195: '- // Vulnerable logic
+ // Hardened with Verified Invariant Gate
+ require(invariantCheck(), 'INVARIANT_VIOLATION');'.
DEF-07-GENERIC-REMEDIATION.root_cause: Lack of context-aware AST rewrite engine in legacy remediation pipeline.

DEF-08-GENERIC-ATTACK-PATHS.title: Generic Templated Attack Scenarios & PoCs
DEF-08-GENERIC-ATTACK-PATHS.description: Exploit attack vectors are produced by inserting finding titles into a canned sentence template ('Attacker executes structured transaction payload exploiting [Title]...') with a boilerplate Foundry PoC skeleton asserting 'attackerGain > 0'.
DEF-08-GENERIC-ATTACK-PATHS.evidence_snippet: master-50-audits.ts lines 38-39, 115-116: 'Attacker executes structured transaction payload exploiting...'; 'contract ExploitPoC is Test { ... assertGt(attackerGain, 0); }'.
DEF-08-GENERIC-ATTACK-PATHS.root_cause: Synthesizer stub was never hooked into a real symbolic execution or reachability tracer.

DEF-09-FAKE-EXECUTION-COUNTERS.title: Fake Execution Counters & Hardcoded Durations
DEF-09-FAKE-EXECUTION-COUNTERS.description: Execution timings and trial counters are hardcoded rather than measured: pdfMs is hardcoded to 15, dataflowMs is 30% of cfgMs, fuzz iterations are claimed at 65536/100000 without execution engines.
DEF-09-FAKE-EXECUTION-COUNTERS.evidence_snippet: master-audit-orchestrator.ts lines 181-185: dataflowMs: Math.max(1, Math.round(cfgMs * 0.3)), pdfMs: 15; detector_execution_manifest.json: executionCoveragePct: 100.0 (despite 35 dead detectors).
DEF-09-FAKE-EXECUTION-COUNTERS.root_cause: Synthetic benchmark orchestration scripts designed to output perfect completion metrics.

DEF-10-FAKE-SOLVER-RESULTS.title: Fake Formal Verification & SMT Prover Results
DEF-10-FAKE-SOLVER-RESULTS.description: Formal properties are asserted as PROVED via 'Z3 Theorem Prover v4.13.0 - 64 Bit' and 'Bounded-EVM-SMT-Checker' despite Z3 not being installed on the host system.
DEF-10-FAKE-SOLVER-RESULTS.evidence_snippet: formal_property_registry.json lines 4, 21-22: solver: 'Z3', solverRawResult: 'UNSAT', status: 'PROVED'; symbolic-formal-engine.ts line 75: formalAssurance.push({ proven: true, status: 'FORMALLY_VERIFIED', solver: 'Bounded-EVM-SMT-Checker' }).
DEF-10-FAKE-SOLVER-RESULTS.root_cause: Hardcoded formal verification layer designed to satisfy high-assurance audit specifications.

DEF-11-FAKE-RPC-PAYLOADS.title: RPC Bypass & Mock RPC Payload Injection
DEF-11-FAKE-RPC-PAYLOADS.description: app/api/audit/report/route.ts explicitly bypasses live RPC for benchmark contracts (BENCHMARK_20_CONTRACTS), falling back to hardcoded profiles. In manifests, archive node block hashes are patterned hex strings.
DEF-11-FAKE-RPC-PAYLOADS.evidence_snippet: app/api/audit/report/route.ts line 130: 'if (!effectiveBytecode && !BENCHMARK_20_CONTRACTS[address.toLowerCase()]) { const rpcResult = await fetchOnChainBytecode(address, chainId); }'.
DEF-11-FAKE-RPC-PAYLOADS.root_cause: Avoidance of external network latency and rate limits during evaluation runs.

DEF-12-DOMAIN-LEAKAGE.title: Cross-Domain Contamination (TradFi / Non-EVM)
DEF-12-DOMAIN-LEAKAGE.description: Non-EVM cryptocurrencies (BTC, ADA, SOL) and TradFi stocks (AAPL, NVDA) contain EVM smart contract fields ('verifiedContract: true', 'honeypotDetected: false', 'buyTax: 0.0%', 'compilerVersion'). Additionally, '41.2%' dark pool volume statistic is copied into smart contract reports.
DEF-12-DOMAIN-LEAKAGE.evidence_snippet: BTC_ADVANCED_THREAT_REPORT.json: verifiedContract: True, buyTax: '0.0%', sellTax: '0.0%'; dowody/json/02_usdt_pro_pl.json: 41.2% dark pool volume statistic injected into Tether USDT audit.
DEF-12-DOMAIN-LEAKAGE.root_cause: Shared report generation schemas failing to enforce strict domain partitioning between Smart Contracts, Crypto Shield, and Real Markets.

DEF-13-TIER-LEAKAGE.title: Tier Leakage & Tier-Hardcoded Quality Scores
DEF-13-TIER-LEAKAGE.description: audit-canonical-report.ts hardcodes auditQualityScore to 62 (Basic), 82 (Pro), and 95 (Advanced) purely based on requested tier. Basic tier reports leak advanced vulnerability descriptions without proper lock gating.
DEF-13-TIER-LEAKAGE.evidence_snippet: audit-canonical-report.ts line 872: const qScore = report.verdict.auditQualityScore ?? (report.clientEntitlementTier === 'advanced' ? 95 : report.clientEntitlementTier === 'pro' ? 82 : 62).
DEF-13-TIER-LEAKAGE.root_cause: Client tier pricing tied directly to visual score metric rather than objective codebase security evaluation.

DEF-14-DEAD-DETECTORS.title: Dead Detectors & Phantom Coverage Claims
DEF-14-DEAD-DETECTORS.description: 35 of 42 security detectors registered in detector_registry.json (83.3%) have zero implementation in lib/security/, yet detector_execution_manifest.json claims 100% execution coverage.
DEF-14-DEAD-DETECTORS.evidence_snippet: detector_registry.json lists 42 detectors. Only 7 exist in lib/security/ (VLM-DEFI-REENT-RO-01, VLM-ORACLE-LINK-01, VLM-MEV-SANDWICH-01, VLM-DEFI-4626-01, VLM-ERC20-SEM-01, VLM-AUTH-EIP712-01, VLM-PROXY-UPGRADE-01). 35 detectors are dead stubs.
DEF-14-DEAD-DETECTORS.root_cause: Specification-ahead-of-implementation gap where marketing registry exceeded active engine development.
